definitions.explanation: A tailored jacket, typically single-breasted, worn as part of a school uniform or as semi-formal/business-casual wear. In Japan, strongly associated with school uniforms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紺色|こんいろ}→紺色：13792_koniro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ブレザー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: I put on a navy blazer.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制服|せいふく}→制服：03086_seifuku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ブレザーだ。
examples.english: This high school's uniform is a blazer style.

examples.japanese: ⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ブレザー⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦スラックス→スラックス：18433_surakkusu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧だ。

notes:
From English "blazer." In Japan, often evokes school uniforms — many junior high and high schools have adopted ブレザー-style uniforms in place of the older ⟦{学|がく}ラン→学ラン：18414_gakuran⟧/⟦セーラー{服|ふく}→セーラー服：17677_seeraafuku⟧ styles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ブレザー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧: to wear a blazer
- ブレザー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制服|せいふく}→制服：03086_seifuku⟧: blazer-style uniform
- ⟦{紺|こん}→紺：03885_kon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ブレザー: navy blazer
- ブレザー⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: someone dressed in a blazer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ジャケット→ジャケット：04522_jaketto⟧: jacket — broader term covering many jacket styles, including blazers
- ⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧: suit — a matching jacket and trousers/skirt; more formal than ブレザー
